steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the range or disconnect power before servicing. Resistance checks require power off and disconnected harnesses. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Inspect ACU and harness connections
steps.body: Power off. Inspect all connections to main control (ACU). Reseat loose connectors.

steps.title: Line voltage at terminal block

steps.title: Gas regulator solenoid resistance
steps.body: Power off. Disconnect leads. Measure across solenoid terminals — 216 Ω ±10%.

steps.title: DSI input voltage and spark gap
steps.body: Verify 102–132 VAC L1–N at DSI. Recommended spark gap 0.125 in (3.18 mm). Visually verify spark on ignition.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify 102–132 VAC L1–N at DSI. Recommended spark gap 0.125 in (3.18 mm). Visually verify spark on ignition.

steps.title: Inspect HMI connections
steps.body: Power off. Inspect connections between HMI assembly and ACU. Reseat if loose.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Inspect connections between HMI assembly and ACU. Reseat if loose.

steps.title: Repair HMI harness
steps.body: Repair harness, restore power, allow 60 sec for ACU to identify HMI.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Repair harness, restore power, allow 60 sec for ACU to identify HMI.

steps.title: HMI 12 VDC at ACU P3
steps.body: With connectors attached and power on, verify 12 VDC at ACU pin outs P3-1 to P3-2 per component chart.

steps.title: Verify room-temperature failure
steps.body: Enter Service Diagnostics. Confirm oven sensor at room temp (50–90°F) and F3E0 displayed matches this test.

steps.title: Oven RTD resistance P22-1 to P22-2
